title: Non-consensus flanking sequence of hundreds of base pairs around in vivo binding sites: statistical beacons for transcription factor scanning
authors: Kateřina Faltejsková; Josef Šulc; Jiří Vondrášek
one_liner_zh: 该文通过ChIP-seq/Cut&Tag数据分析转录因子结合位点周围数千碱基的序列特征（GC含量、二核苷酸频率），提出粗扫描机制，但缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，属于广义TF-DNA互作序列统计研究，对本课题有背景参考价值。
abstract: It was long suspected that for specific DNA binding by a transcription factor, the flanks of the binding motifs can play an important role. By a thorough analysis of the DNA sequence in the broad context (± 5000 bp) of in vivo binding sites (as identified in a ChIP-seq or a Cut&Tag experiment), we show that the average GC content is in most cases statistically significantly increased around the binding site in a patch spanning 1000–1500 bp. This increase was observed consistently in experiment targeting the same TF in different cell lines. The surrounding of binding sites of certain TFs like MYC display a directional alteration of dinucleotide frequencies. We attempt to explain these preferences by alteration in DNA shape features as well as by potential cooperation with other TFs. We observed differences in sequence affinity to various potential cooperating TFs between cell lines. Altogether, we propose that the observed feature distortion is indicative of a coarse scanning mechanism that helps TFs find the target binding site. Graphical Abstract Key Messages We prove an increase in GC content 1000–1500 bp both upstream and downstream of the binding site. We observed a funnel-like sequence signature of thousands of bp that is shared between most cell lines. We propose an explanation based on helix shape and binding affinities of potential cooperating TFs, supported by crosslinking the ChIP-seq (Cut&Tag) experiments with ATAC-seq experiments.
abstract_zh: 长期以来，人们一直怀疑，在转录因子对DNA的特异性结合中，结合基序两侧的侧翼序列可能扮演重要角色。通过对体内结合位点（如通过ChIP-seq或Cut&Tag实验鉴定）周围广泛区域（±5000 bp）的DNA序列进行彻底分析，我们发现在大多数情况下，结合位点周围的平均GC含量在跨越1000–1500 bp的片段中统计学上显著增加。这一增加在不同细胞系中针对同一转录因子的实验中一致观察到。某些转录因子（如MYC）的结合位点周围显示出二核苷酸频率的方向性改变。我们尝试通过DNA形状特征的改变以及与其他转录因子的潜在合作来解释这些偏好。我们观察到不同细胞系之间对各种潜在合作转录因子的序列亲和力存在差异。总体而言，我们提出观察到的特征扭曲表明存在一种粗略扫描机制，有助于转录因子找到目标结合位点。图形摘要 关键信息 我们证明了结合位点上游和下游1000–1500 bp区域内GC含量的增加。我们观察到数千bp的漏斗状序列特征，这在大多数细胞系中是共有的。我们提出了一种基于螺旋形状和潜在合作转录因子结合亲和力的解释，并通过将ChIP-seq（Cut&Tag）实验与ATAC-seq实验交叉验证来支持这一观点。
